scope: Bounded independent market purchase-form adversarial review, not rights/source acceptance or runtime validation.
checks: All82 form descriptions and recipe associations reviewed; each has positive actual-form evidence in the five-chain panel and every selected code exists in global ingredients.csv.
Five-chain status counts recomputed. Same-chain multiple products/duplicates do not increase chain count. A chain without qualifying evidence remains UNCERTAIN, not an absence claim.
All103 one-based observation references resolve to AVAILABLE matching-code records. Regional chain presence is paired with current neutral/chainwide product evidence, never used alone.

Exact material differences preserved: frozen cauliflower, frozen corn, frozen edamame, frozen green beans, frozen Atlantic cod, raw bone-in versus boneless thighs, quick oats versus ordinary oats, iodized salt, young potatoes and sweet Yalta onion.
Source-directed cutting, peeling, squeezing and cooking retain original prepared quantities; no inferred yield/conversion.
No selected no-salt/low-sodium/fixed-specialty broth, canned bean or frozen orange-concentrate ingredient is cleared by a generic substitute.
Milk1% evidence exact. Generic lowfat/plain and nonfat Greek families retain actual1.5%/0.1% skim evidence, not mathematical-zero claims.

Canola evidence restricted to cold salad dressing. Sesame saute selects specific ELEYA identity with official frying-use corroboration; KOTANYI no-frying and PREMIUM CLUB no-heat remain excluded. Corroborating Yarche is not a counted availability chain.
Raw sesame seeds explicitly select original card's home-toast3minutes medium heat in small stock pot. No unsupported raw/toasted equivalence.

Spring sweet onion selects explicitly sweet red Yalta member; young potatoes remain young/tiny. Frozen green beans selected under parent-approved source-generic green-bean member, not source-explicit frozen language, and no thawing/time adjustment invented.
Pear/Orange sauce uses existing PEAR and ORANGE with source¾cup pure prepared juice; no invented orange count/yield or packaged nectar assumption.
Standard Roasted Carrots olive oil is a parent-selected generic vegetable-oil member; explicit olive-oil wording in spicy variant is not asserted to mandate standard choice.
remaining_integration: Coverage file at audit time still contains six CauliflowerRice rows instead of three PearOrangeSauce rows. This is an identified source-selection snapshot difference. Data/QA owns final coverage/matrix parity and final assembly. No other nonwater recipe/code mismatch was found.
limitations: Catalogue compatibility is not current store inventory or guaranteed year-round stock.
One-chain ordinary concepts are RU_AVAILABLE with explicit reasons, not RU_MASS_MARKET.
Rights acceptance, source execution safety, recipe categorization and final PR verification are outside this bounded market audit.
